parameters.formDescription: Press Continue to see the appointment before you cancel it.

parameters.content:
## d2 · Clinic Cancel
The cancel link in confirmation and reminder emails opens this form with the booking ID and its secret token filled in (hidden). d0 looks the booking up: wrong or missing token → "this link doesn't work" (nothing about the booking is shown). Online cancelling closes 2 hours before the appointment.

On "Yes, cancel it": Check Again asks d0 once more (the page may have sat open, or the booking was cancelled in another tab), then status → Cancelled, cancelled_at stamped (PKT), the time is free again, cancellation email sent. Form URL: /form/clinic-cancel?id=…&t=…

### Pages
Finish chooses: cancelled · cancelled but email failed · kept (said No, or left the page for 30 minutes) · not found · already cancelled · too late · already passed. If Check Again says no, its page is shown instead. All pages are built by d0's Clinic Templates.
